goal: Implement, validate, integrate, and baseline the independent ai-code-benchmark module as Infoapex P4.5 before continuing P5.
nonGoals: Claim statistically authoritative model rankings from the bounded pilot.
Replace unit, integration, security, or release gates with benchmark scores.
Allow the system under test to grade its own output.

tasks.goal: Freeze architecture, threat model, experimental protocol, and feasibility of all benchmark arms.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ADR, threat model, preregistration rules, and arm feasibility decision are versioned.

tasks.goal: Create the standalone package, versioned contracts, dataset loader, and subprocess arm adapters.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The package builds and contract, dataset, and adapter tests pass.

tasks.goal: Implement isolated scheduling, recovery, metrics, independent evaluation, statistics, and reports.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Runtime and analysis are deterministic, resumable, and covered by failure-path tests.

tasks.goal: Build and execute the hermetic deterministic benchmark harness.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The deterministic three-arm suite passes with reproducible artifacts and expected score ordering.

gates.evidenceContract: Harness exits successfully and writes a verified report.

tasks.goal: Run a preregistered bounded live pilot and publish an explicitly non-authoritative verdict.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Pilot preflight, raw observations, report, limitations, and verdict are preserved.

tasks.goal: Integrate the pinned module into the bundle, update release gates and roadmap, and publish the P5 baseline.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bundle, provenance, documentation, release smoke, and P4.5 gates pass.

gates.evidenceContract: Root test and bundle gates exit successfully.
